dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Would you like to visit that floating Central Laboratory? If not... Then there's not a lot I have for you.

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Will anyone really come visit this place...

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Hello, Honorary Senior Researcher. You mean, "What is there to even visit here"?

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Well, if we want to get specific about potential attractions... I guess it would be the airborne Central Laboratory.

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: According to Messieurs Raimondo and Choiseul, the institute will convert that laboratory into a Safety Exhibition.

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Inside, there will be pictures from all the Institute's old research projects...

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Though... I don't see what those projects have to do with a Safety Exhibition...

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: And would anyone want to visit such an exhibition...

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Goodbye. I'd better get on with my work...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything else to visit around here?

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: Monsieur Choiseul said the Academic Assembly Hall is going to be renovated and reopened to host regular exhibitions of the products Institute research.

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: But all we have to show at the moment would be clockwork puppets like the Artificed Dancers...

dialogues.speaker: Conjat
dialogues.text: If nothing else, we can rebuild Mary-Ann Memorial Park. At least the scenery there is pretty nice...
